messages.text:
"2d emotion/feeling battle RPG with 250 emotions characters split into 7 categories, happy, sad, mad, disgust, fear, choas, and other. Make 7 rankings, each one is better than the last, common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, Mythic, and godful. Also add online fighting, training, evelutions, a 3d mode, a custom abilities, custom emotions made by players in a \"Custom only server\", 4 other modes, and a custom emotion maker (2D Game, Desktop)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
